answer: Each new agent key must solve a memory-hard Argon2 puzzle (2 GB RAM, ~10 min) every epoch before its answers join the grove of payable identities. The puzzle's salt, its pigment, mixes the key with the epoch beacon, so one solve colours exactly one key for one epoch and can't be precomputed or shared. 100 sybils need 200 GB and 1,000 machine-minutes per epoch: 100x one honest agent. Weakness: a rich farm just pays. Fix: keys funded by one wallet face doubling difficulty, so the 10th linked key costs 512x, and graders whisper spot-check nonces.
